_description: S3 / CDSE eodata endpoint configuration. Used by src/save_images_data.py and model/s3_utils.py. Credentials are loaded from .config/aws/credentials (profile [cdse]) via src.credentials, with .s3cfg walk and AWS_* env vars as fallbacks (all gitignored).
safe_directory_detection: treat as directory if last path segment has no file extension OR STAC type is inode/directory

error_recovery.on_404_headobject: fallback to list_objects_v2 with key as prefix
error_recovery.on_empty_safe_dir: delete and re-fetch — do NOT skip
